name: Shorts from long videos
description: Use when cutting a standalone short out of a long recording: a moment that makes sense on its own, a clean start and finish, reframed to vertical. Rank candidates for this video; never promise views.
verification: Pass or fail comes only from the Editing Studio's checks on the rendered file (QUALITY_GATES); the skill adds no tool, approval or setting.
